steps.name: When I log in as a manager with username "siri" and password "password"
Then I should be on the manager dashboard
Given an employee has a pending expense "Personal software license" for "89.99" in category "Software"
When I view the pending expense queue
Then I should see the expense "Personal software license" with amount "89.99" in the pending queue
When I review the expense "Personal software license" as "denied" with comment "Not a reimbursable business expense"
Then I should see a confirmation that the review was submitted
And the expense "Personal software license" should no longer appear in the pending queue
